notes: Inspected the full body and caller. It gates on byte input+0x428, resolves an opaque context value and tests low 16-bit flags 1/2, then maps an integer to itself, 16, or -2 depending on bounds and state. Caller passes an integer-converted attribute result. The exact slot/domain semantics are unresolved, so leave unnamed.

Confirmed. The body queries selector 0x15; returns true for status 1 when the global service word at 0x700227e6a0 is 1, or status 2 when it is 0; all other cases return false. Callers consume the result as a Boolean gate.

The body takes an index, obtains a global array base, resolves indices 0..2 to entries at base + index*0x148 + 0xa8, reads attribute 0x11 through player_attribute_value_or_zero, converts the float to signed int, and returns it (or zero on lookup failure). Callers store the integer result. The proposed 'context entry' wording is not directly established, so this narrower name is better supported.

Confirmed. The body writes the getter result for selector 0x13 to record+0x0c; when that value is not 6 and the global object's +4 word equals 3, it overwrites the record field with 9, then returns the stored value. Its caller invokes it on a local record prepared by the preceding helper.
